correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs exact ordered-pair expected outbreak score for every tree-deletion candidate; leaf domination; the exact D_t and adjacent D differences; coefficient sign-variation and one-crossing via Descartes; boundary D_t(1)=k(k-1)+2t(t+k-L); a maximum integer quadratic yielding the iff criterion; strict monotonicity under tail extension and a positive finite-length correction yielding the unique limiting root. The direct exact-rational percolation enumeration independently agrees in 306 candidate deletions, with 126 difference checks. No finite test is presented as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A single scarce vaccination site balances a high-degree core against a long path separator, creating a natural, mathematically motivated structural competition. The theorem gives a complete all-size integer boundary for whether site preference changes, proves at most one irreversible transmissibility switch, determines the best interior site and identifies a nontrivial limiting critical transmissibility. This is not merely a previously known finite eight-node benchmark or generic tree connectivity identity; it yields an infinite family phase diagram and a practical mechanism for transmission-dependent node rankings.
